reason_for_revision.en: Calibration v0.1 exposed ambiguity in absent versus incorrect and let the judge choose an overall label that conflicted with the written rule. No experiment answer had been seen.
reason_for_revision.ru: Калибровка v0.1 нашла двусмысленность между «нет ответа» и «неверный ответ», а также позволяла судье выбрать итог, противоречащий написанному правилу. Ответы эксперимента ещё никто не видел.

definitions.correct: The answer affirms the expected meaning.
definitions.incorrect: The answer denies the expected meaning or affirms a conflicting alternative.
definitions.absent: The answer makes no relevant claim about this component.
definitions.unclear: The answer makes a relevant claim, but its meaning cannot be decided safely.

judge_outputs.quote_rule: correct, incorrect, and unclear require an exact answer quote; absent requires null

derived_by_code.contradiction: true when either component is incorrect
derived_by_code.overall_incorrect: any component incorrect, or both components absent
derived_by_code.note: The LLM cannot choose or override these derived fields.

unchanged: owner reviews all disagreements plus 24 agreements

claim_boundary.en: v0.2 repairs the ruler using only synthetic calibration. It does not improve or relabel any E005 answer yet.
claim_boundary.ru: v0.2 исправляет линейку только по искусственной калибровке. Она пока не улучшает и не переоценивает ни один ответ E005.
